lines: NBA and EuroLeague look pretty similar.
But the rules can change the game.
In the NBA, each quarter lasts twelve minutes.
From the exact same spot, it's a three in EuroLeague...
but only two in the NBA.
Five and you're out in EuroLeague.
And this one actually changes defense.
In the NBA, you can't just camp in the paint for more than three seconds without actively guarding anyone.
EuroLeague doesn't have that violation, so bigs can protect the rim differently.
Which rules would you rather play under?
